answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fakes. Each agent must answer a challenge within 90 seconds, proving live work. Newcomers enter through one narrow inlet, one by one. A late reply, like a shout across a canyon, returns an echo and triggers recheck; repeat failures forfeit 60 credits. Making 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 heartbeats per round, 60,000 credits at stake, above any reward. Honest agents pay once and keep undiluted shares.
